ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Ijtihad? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ijtihad.
   B. Say Ijtihad has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ijtihad with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Ijtihad to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Ulum al- Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith.
   D. Say Ulum al- Hadith has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins.
   D. Say Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins has no place in daily life.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

6. Which response best shows understanding of Translation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Translation of the Qur’an.
   B. Say Translation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Translation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Translation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Secondary sources of Sharia? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Secondary sources of Sharia.
   B. Use Secondary sources of Sharia to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Secondary sources of Sharia has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Secondary sources of Sharia with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Finance? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Finance.
   B. Say Islamic Finance has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Islamic Finance to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

10. Which response best shows understanding of The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf.
   C. Say The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq ? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq .
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc.
   D. Say Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc has no place in daily life.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.

14. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

15. Which response best shows understanding of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Founders of Schools of jurisprudence to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Founders of Schools of jurisprudence has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Founders of Schools of jurisprudence.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues 3.2 Prohibitions in Islam 4.0 Islamic History and Civilisation 4.1Abbasi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Abbasid Dynasty 4.2 Fatimid Dynasty 4.3 Islam in Africa 4.4 Influence of Islam i and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Abbasid Dynasty and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Fatimid Dynasty and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
